_about: Places where battles happen, per era, each with a short description used in the battle briefing. Used by scraper/storyteller.py (without repeats inside one expedition). Descriptions must not name a nemesis.

dawn.name: a jungle hut beside a phoenix roost
dawn.detail: Kiri's notes are still pinned to the walls, curling in the damp. Overhead, the roost is strangely quiet.

dawn.name: glass sand where phoenix fire struck
dawn.detail: The ground here has been melted and cooled into ripples of green glass. Nothing grows in the scorch marks.

dawn.name: a river delta choked with giant reeds
dawn.detail: The reeds stand taller than a man and close behind you as you pass. Something large has broken a path through them.

dawn.name: a cliff of empty nesting ledges
dawn.detail: Hundreds of nests line the cliff face, all abandoned. The flock has fled, and phoenixes do not flee from anything.

dawn.name: a forest of fern-trees older than any city
dawn.detail: Light barely reaches the forest floor. The ferns are dying from the top down, as if something had drunk the sun out of them.

dawn.name: a researcher's abandoned outpost
dawn.detail: The door hangs open. Instruments lie smashed on the floor, and the last entry in the logbook stops in the middle of a sentence.

dawn.name: a hot spring in the jungle's heart
dawn.detail: Steam rises from the pools and the rocks are slick with moss. Animal tracks lead to the water and none lead away.

world_that_was.name: the university halls of Erythiza
world_that_was.detail: Lecture rooms stand empty, chalk still on the boards. In the laboratories below, something hums that should have been switched off long ago.

world_that_was.name: Port Hanon's docks
world_that_was.detail: Ships ride at anchor with no one aboard. The City Guard has sealed the warehouses, and the gulls will not land on them.

world_that_was.name: a steam-train line through open plains
world_that_was.detail: The train stands stopped on the tracks, its boiler cold. The carriages are empty; the luggage is still on the racks.

world_that_was.name: the brass streets of Karek
world_that_was.detail: The city shines like fire in the sun, all brass domes and archive towers. Few people walk the streets now, and those who do walk quickly.

world_that_was.name: the shrine where names are given up
world_that_was.detail: Hundreds of names are carved into its walls, each one a person who walked away from the world. The newest are still fresh.

world_that_was.name: a toll bridge over a dry river
world_that_was.detail: The tollkeeper's booth is empty, the coins still in the box. Beyond it, the road is lined with abandoned carts.

world_that_was.name: a lighthouse on the M'hlark coast
world_that_was.detail: The lamp still turns, but the keeper is gone. From the gallery you can see the harbor towns, unusually dark for the hour.

calamity.name: a market turned slaughterhouse
calamity.detail: Stalls lie overturned, their awnings torn. No one has come back for the goods, or for the dead.

calamity.name: green-glass statues on a hillside
calamity.detail: Men and women stand frozen in green crystal, mouths open, hands raised. Some of them were kneeling.

calamity.name: a refugee camp where elders rub blistered feet
calamity.detail: Tents of patched canvas huddle around a dying fire. The elders say the world used to be much smaller, back when there were trains.

calamity.name: the road out of Erythiza
calamity.detail: The road is lined with what people dropped as they ran: books, shoes, a child's toy. Behind you, the horizon is the wrong colour.

calamity.name: a farmstead with its doors left open
calamity.detail: Bread on the table, a chair pushed back. Whoever lived here left in a hurry, or did not leave at all.

calamity.name: the glass archive of Karek
calamity.detail: The great archive is a mountain of green glass now, and the books inside it are trapped like flies in amber.

calamity.name: a bridge choked with abandoned carts
calamity.detail: The carts were left where they stood, horses and all. Nothing on the far bank moves.

descent.name: the dead town of Donnyton
descent.detail: Someone had mended the roofs and planted gardens here. The gardens are overgrown now, and the doors are barred from the inside.

descent.name: a swamp whose ground turns to mud
descent.detail: The ground softens with every step until it pulls at your boots. The trees are grey and leafless, and the water does not reflect the sky.

descent.name: the crystal fields of the Blighted God
descent.detail: Emerald spires rise from the ground as far as you can see, and in every one of them there is a shape.

descent.name: the red-lit threshold of Gravehold
descent.detail: The cave mouth glows red, as if a great fire burned inside. Beyond it lies the city Brama promised: dark, vast and silent.

descent.name: a ruined watchtower on the old coast road
descent.detail: From the top you can see the sea, and the dark shapes moving under its surface.

descent.name: the Sisterhood's night camp
descent.detail: The sisters keep the fire small and the watch doubled. The Followers sleep with their boots on.

descent.name: a mountain pass choked with snow
descent.detail: The pass is narrow and the snow is deep. Old bones stick out of the drifts, and not all of them are animal.

old_gravehold.name: the dirt market
old_gravehold.detail: The stalls are half empty and the haggling is quiet. Merchants keep glancing up at the vault of the cave, as if waiting for the bells.

old_gravehold.name: Chasmwalk
old_gravehold.detail: The beggars of Chasmwalk have stopped begging. They sit at the edge of the chasm and stare into it.

old_gravehold.name: the balustrade above the city
old_gravehold.detail: From the balustrade the whole city spreads out below: the hovels, the market, the torches along the walls. Some of the torches have gone out.

old_gravehold.name: The Depths where the dead are thrown
old_gravehold.detail: Here Gravehold lays its dead, because dirt is too precious to spare for graves. Nobody comes here willingly, and nobody lingers.

old_gravehold.name: the ruins of the Cragbellows
old_gravehold.detail: Rubble and old soot. Someone has been here recently: there are fresh candles, and masks left on the stones.

old_gravehold.name: the sealed cave mouth
old_gravehold.detail: A mountain of rubble seals the way out, as it has for generations. A little light seeps through the cracks, and one stone has been moved.

old_gravehold.name: the frozen tunnels far below
old_gravehold.detail: Your breath steams in the torchlight and frost covers the walls. The cold down here is not natural.

old_gravehold.name: the Far Hollow hovels
old_gravehold.detail: The hovels were rebuilt after the fire, but the stone is still black. People here sleep in their clothes.

fall.name: burning streets under a giant breach
fall.detail: Gravehold is on fire. Above the city a breach turns slowly, larger than any you have ever seen.

fall.name: collapsing tunnels
fall.detail: Dust falls from the ceiling with every tremor. Somewhere behind you a tunnel gives way, and the screaming stops.

fall.name: the first sight of the green surface
fall.detail: Trees. Sky. Wind on your face for the first time in your life. And something moving at the edge of the forest.

fall.name: the survivors' camp at the tunnel's end
fall.detail: Hundreds of survivors huddle under the open sky, flinching at every bird. The wounded outnumber the healers.

fall.name: the sinkhole where Gravehold fell
fall.detail: The ground has collapsed into a pit so deep you cannot see the bottom. Smoke still rises from it.

fall.name: a ridge overlooking the lost city
fall.detail: From the ridge you can see where Gravehold was. There is only a scar in the earth now, and the scar is moving.

fall.name: a flooded passage beneath the ruins
fall.detail: Black water rises to your waist. Somewhere ahead, beyond the dark, you can hear the surface wind.

new_gravehold.name: swamps north of the city
new_gravehold.detail: The trails north of the city sink into bog and mist. Insects drone everywhere, until suddenly they don't.

new_gravehold.name: a willow grove carved with glyphs
new_gravehold.detail: The willows sway without wind. Someone has carved glyphs into their trunks, and the glyphs are still warm to the touch.

new_gravehold.name: Southpost's watchtowers
new_gravehold.detail: Southpost keeps its signal fires ready and its gates shut. The guards on the towers are watching the forest, not the road.

new_gravehold.name: the sinkhole over Old Gravehold
new_gravehold.detail: The pit where the old city fell is fenced now, and watched. The watchers say the rubble at the bottom has been shifting.

new_gravehold.name: sunken Gravehold under black water
new_gravehold.detail: Rain has filled the ruins of Old Gravehold. Under the black water you can see rooftops, and lights where there should be none.

new_gravehold.name: Azer's sigil-marked forest
new_gravehold.detail: Sigils hang from the branches to keep the Portalborn away. Many of them have been torn down.

new_gravehold.name: the iridescent mountains of the Void
new_gravehold.detail: The sky is every colour at once and the mountains float, thin as bones. Time feels wrong here: your shadow moves a moment late.

new_gravehold.name: the farmlands beyond the walls
new_gravehold.detail: Fields of grain stretch to the forest's edge. The harvest should have started days ago, but the farmers will not go out.

new_gravehold.name: the Northern Outpost
new_gravehold.detail: The Northern Outpost is the last stop before the wilds. Its commander has doubled the watch and stopped sending patrols.

civil_war.name: an exile's cottage in the wilds
civil_war.detail: A small cottage at the edge of the wilds, its garden carefully kept. Its owner was sent here for asking the wrong questions.

civil_war.name: Azer's village square
civil_war.detail: The square is full of Tethered mages, standing in pairs. They do not trust you, and they have reason not to.

civil_war.name: New Gravehold's high walls
civil_war.detail: The walls are twice as high as the old ones, and every gate is guarded by mages who have chosen a side.

civil_war.name: a Void portal opened in a field
civil_war.detail: A portal hangs over the wheat like a wound in the air. The crops around it have turned grey.

civil_war.name: Southpost, rebuilt
civil_war.detail: New timber over old ashes. The people of Southpost have rebuilt twice now, and they are tired of it.

civil_war.name: a hidden meeting place in the woods
civil_war.detail: Masks hang from the branches and the ground is scorched in a circle. Someone has been practising magic that is no longer allowed.

civil_war.name: the council hall at night
civil_war.detail: The hall is empty but the lamps are lit. Someone has left a map on the table, with your route marked in red.

after.name: Souston's sunny lanes
after.detail: Souston is quiet, safe and very proud of it. The glyphs on its gates were carved by Camellia herself, and they have never failed. Until now.

after.name: the swamp of Faen
after.detail: The swamp village stands on stilts above dark water. The people of Faen remember an old war, and they do not like visitors.

after.name: the pipes of the System beneath Cindercrown
after.detail: Iron pipes run in every direction, sweating and humming. Somewhere in the dark, a Strike team's lanterns flicker and go out.

after.name: a ruin with ancient blueprints
after.detail: The ruin is older than any record. On its walls are drawings of machines that open breaches by themselves.

after.name: the iron gates of Cindercrown
after.detail: The gates of Cindercrown are said to be indestructible. Something has left long scratches in them.

after.name: an overgrown battlefield of the old wars
after.detail: Rusted blades and broken gems lie in the grass, and the children of the nearby village dare each other to touch them.

after.name: a crossroads shrine to the heroes of Gravehold
after.detail: The statues are worn smooth by centuries of rain, but someone still leaves fresh flowers at their feet.
